story: An enterprise buyer asks for a security questionnaire. The strategy tells the model a colleague sends security documents; the model says so and carries on, proposing the hand-over only as a background request. A colleague is asked to send the documents; the conversation stays with the AI (was a hand-over).

turns.lead: Before we go further our security team needs your SOC 2 report and a completed questionnaire.

model.message: Of course. I have asked a colleague to send the security documents over. In the meantime, who else will be involved in the evaluation?
